title: Integrate ObjectUI Console and form controls for first release
body:
This first-release candidate merges the committed ObjectUI stack through `869b0954d6f35c9c4c9dc40b27df23e667ad5836` with fork main `0c58872bf65bc74a09016e3c338f47d7584c1554`. Both histories remain parents of the integration merge. Main’s direct-route navigation fixes and the Console baseline at `3da03952f` are retained; no uncommitted work from the other checkout is included.

The navigation conflicts combine route-derived area/trail selection with package-scoped bare page resolution, lazy application metadata, and readable record breadcrumbs. The standard PageHeader keeps its minimum title width while the workspace variant remains flexible. Date controls, disabled file editing, composite forms, and public React component exports remain covered by focused regressions.

The runtime alignment commit is `76d0c821d2701edbd94999553973bdc6d1c4802b`. Candidate head `de0665ccd8eca1225cd8529b63d9a32b0d520256` also aligns the two live fixtures with the bare page route and the server-paged table footer, retaining the parent/child batch and rejected-request assertions. It completes three widget value-shape entries and their generated CLI schema types, recognizes the dashboard drill-down option already consumed by DatasetWidget, and completes choice-card translations and localized export-format descriptions. The new documentation examples now compile using real exports, controlled values, and typed host callbacks. Regression fixtures follow the current package-scoped metadata and table/form contracts without removing assertions, skipping tests, or changing dependencies.

Validation on Node 24.19.0 and pnpm 10.31.0:
- The complete documentation archive passed `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`: every one of the 695 compiled blocks passed, with no new fragment exemptions. The resolution, sentinel, undeclared-dependency, and root-dependency controls passed. Documentation links passed across the gate’s complete scan surface.
- Targeted app-shell/Console tests passed in their final groups (421 cases). Fields/plugin/parser/stylesheet tests passed (531 cases), and the CLI derivation suite passed separately against the complete archive (13 cases).
- The focused shared-control and locale/default-map groups passed (16, 55, and 196 cases in separate runs). These are scoped results, not a replacement for the full CI run.
- Affected package production/test type checks, Console type checks, and script type checks passed. Changed-file ESLint, mock-inheritance, i18n call-site/default-table, changeset, and whitespace gates passed.
- All nine isolated real-Chrome header geometry cases passed at `6647b138`; their layout implementation is unchanged by the final alignment commit. The original flex-wrap and title-width assertions remain.

The Spec Main Shape workflow previously omitted `patches/` from its sparse checkout. The directory and its regression check are now included (17 workflow tests passed). The [rerun against upstream main](https://github.com/jinyitao123/objectui/actions/runs/37603817809) reached candidate type checking and found real incompatibilities with `objectstack-ai/objectstack@56bf27affbe5e3f5aca8001ed0218d013b04bf22`: missing export-job types, a new `doc` navigation member, and a new `computed` stripped-field reason, plus type equality/declaration failures. This is a failed compatibility probe, not an environment exception. The ordinary locked-dependency type check passed; SDK versions and dependency locks remain unchanged.

[Ordinary CI for final head `de0665ccd`](https://github.com/jinyitao123/objectui/actions/runs/37603818055) completed successfully: all eight source-test shards and the Test summary, Type Check, Build & E2E, Build Docs, and dist pins. Final-head [Lint](https://github.com/jinyitao123/objectui/actions/runs/37603817848) and [documentation-snippet checks](https://github.com/jinyitao123/objectui/actions/runs/37603817703) also passed. [Live E2E](https://github.com/jinyitao123/objectui/actions/runs/37603817833) passed all five cases after the two fixture corrections. The live suite covers the isolated test stack and outgoing parent/child batch payloads; installed employee-flow acceptance remains separate. The sole failing check is the upstream-main compatibility probe described above.

This remains a draft for review. Before prerelease, build Console from a clean archive of the accepted final SHA with `VITE_BASE_PATH=/_console/` and `VITE_UI_PROFILE=compact-enterprise`, then verify the paired Forge artifact lock. This PR does not deploy runtime services or produce the unsigned desktop package. The committed form-control dependency is [ObjectUI PR 1](https://github.com/jinyitao123/objectui/pull/1).
